definitions.gloss: crew member; crew; occupant of a vehicle
definitions.explanation: A person who operates or is on board a vehicle, aircraft, or vessel as part of its crew, or more broadly, any occupant of a vehicle.

examples.japanese: {乗員|じょういん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧だった。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗員|じょういん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十二名|じゅうにめい}です。
examples.english: The crew of this aircraft consists of twelve people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗員|じょういん}{三名|さんめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Three occupants of the vehicle were taken to the hospital after the accident, but their lives are not in danger.

notes:
A compound of {乗|じょう} (to ride/board) and {員|いん} (member/personnel). Used in both professional contexts (crew of an aircraft, ship, or spacecraft) and in general reporting about vehicle occupants.

In news reports, {乗員|じょういん} often appears alongside ⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧ (passengers) in the set phrase {乗員|じょういん}⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧ or ⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧{乗員|じょういん}, covering everyone on board a vehicle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗員|じょういん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all crew/occupants
- {乗員|じょういん}⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧: crew and passengers
- {乗員|じょういん}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of crew/occupants
- {乗員|じょういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rescue crew members

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧: passenger (those being transported, not operating the vehicle)
- {搭乗員|とうじょういん}: crew member (specifically for aircraft)
- ⟦{船員|せんいん}→船員：22495_senin⟧: ship crew member
